subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Her friend laughed when she read it.”?
options: Some students said it was the quietest lunch start ever.
Everyone said they were too full, so Mia put it in the refrigerator.
"That was the first movie your mother and I watched together," he said.
"This is the most honest birthday card I have ever received," she said.
